question: If two circles touch each other internally at exactly one point, how many common tangents can be drawn to both circles?
solution:
**Given:**

Two circles touch each other internally at exactly one point

**Formula used:**

Number of common tangents depends on the position of two circles

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/785bd7ec423aaf9d2e49fb9505c5c6bbb785a0d611f0999e84465d45d94a608a.png] 

⇒ When two circles touch internally, one circle lies inside the other

⇒ At the point of internal contact, only one common tangent is possible

**∴ The number of common tangents drawn to both circles is 1.**
